title: Indian Independence & Dawn of Freedom
description: At the stroke of midnight, India gains independence from British rule. Jawaharlal Nehru delivers his historic 'Tryst with Destiny' speech.

title: Constitution of India Comes into Effect
description: India officially becomes a Sovereign Democratic Republic. Dr. Rajendra Prasad takes oath as the first President of India.

title: Ceasefire in the 1965 Indo-Pak War
description: UN-mandated ceasefire ends the second major war between India and Pakistan. Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri's 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan' slogan defines the era.

title: Vijay Diwas: Bangladesh Liberation War Victory
description: Over 93,000 Pakistani troops surrender unconditionally in Dhaka, leading to the creation of Bangladesh and a historic Indian military victory.

title: Operation Smiling Buddha (Pokhran-I)
description: India successfully conducts its first peaceful nuclear test at Pokhran, Rajasthan, becoming the sixth nation in the world to master nuclear technology.

title: Aryabhata: India's First Satellite Launched
description: ISRO launches its maiden satellite 'Aryabhata', built indigenously under Dr. U.R. Rao, marking India's entry into the space age.

title: Declaration of National Emergency
description: President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed declares an Internal Emergency across India on the recommendation of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.

title: Kapil Dev's India Wins the Cricket World Cup
description: Underdog India stuns two-time defending champion West Indies at Lord's, London, winning the Prudential World Cup and sparking a cricket fever across the subcontinent.

title: Rakesh Sharma Becomes First Indian in Space
description: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma launches aboard Soyuz T-11. When PM Indira Gandhi asks how India looks from space, he famously replies: 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'.

title: The Historic 1991 Liberalization Budget
description: Finance Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh unveils India's historic LPG (Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) reforms, dismantling the Licence Raj.

title: National Technology Day: Pokhran-II Nuclear Tests
description: Under Operation Shakti and the leadership of PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, India conducts five underground nuclear tests at Pokhran.

title: Kargil Vijay Diwas: Operation Vijay Concludes
description: The Indian Armed Forces successfully evict Pakistani infiltrators and recapture high-altitude posts in Kargil and Dras.

title: India Wins Inaugural ICC T20 World Cup
description: Young captain MS Dhoni leads India to victory against Pakistan in a dramatic final in Johannesburg, sparking the global revolution of T20 cricket.

title: Abhinav Bindra Wins India's First Individual Olympic Gold
description: Shooter Abhinav Bindra captures gold in the Men's 10m Air Rifle event at the Beijing Olympics, ending India's 108-year wait for an individual gold medal.

title: Chandrayaan-1 Launches: Water on the Moon Discovered
description: ISRO launches its first lunar mission, which subsequently confirms the presence of water molecules on the Moon's surface.

title: India Lifts ICC Cricket World Cup at Wankhede
description: MS Dhoni hits the winning six at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium as India defeats Sri Lanka to win the World Cup after 28 years.

title: Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) Enters Mars Orbit
description: ISRO creates world history by becoming the first space agency to reach Martian orbit on its very first attempt, and at a fraction of NASA's budget.

title: Neeraj Chopra Wins Historic Track & Field Olympic Gold
description: Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra hurls 87.58m at Tokyo 2020 Olympics to become the first Indian ever to win an Olympic track-and-field gold.

title: Chandrayaan-3 Lands on Lunar South Pole
description: India's Vikram lander makes a soft touchdown near the Moon's South Pole, making India the first nation in history to land near the lunar south pole.

title: India Wins ICC Men's T20 World Cup in Barbados
description: Rohit Sharma's Men in Blue defeat South Africa in a thrilling final in Bridgetown, Barbados, to claim their second T20 World Cup trophy.
